blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–2026 NBA Cup action on Friday, November 13 (November 14 in the Philippines) saw the Spurs, Blazers, Rockets, Heat, Grizzlies and Bulls score victories, with San Antonio extending its winning streak to 11 games. Orlando Magic beat Milwaukee Bucks, 107-99 Franz Wagner scored 35 points, dished out 12 assists and grabbed nine rebounds, falling one rebound short of his first career triple-double. Desmond Bane added 21 points as Orlando improved to 2-0 in NBA Cup group play. Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 18 points; Goga Bitadze and Tristan da Silva each scored 12 for Orlando.
